title: Deep Time-series Forecasting Needs Kernelized Moment Balancing
abstract: arXiv:2602.00717v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep time-series forecasting can be formulated as a distribution balancing problem aimed at aligning the distribution of the forecasts and ground truths. According to Imbens' criterion, balancing two distributions requires that their first moments be identical with respect to any balancing function. We demonstrate that existing objectives enforce moment matching only for one or two predefined balancing functions, thus failing to achieve full distribution balance. To address this limitation, we propose direct forecasting with kernelized moment balancing (KMB-DF). Unlike existing objectives, KMB-DF adaptively selects the most informative balancing functions from a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) to enforce sufficient distribution balancing. A tractable and differentiable formulation is derived to enable estimation from empirical samples and seamless integration into gradient-based training pipelines. Extensive experiments acros

translated_title: 深度时间序列预测需要核化矩平衡
translated_abstract: 深度时间序列预测可以被表述为一个分布平衡问题，其目标是对齐预测值与真实值的分布。根据 Imbens 准则，要平衡两个分布，需要它们关于任意平衡函数的一阶矩完全相同。我们证明，现有目标函数仅针对一个或两个预定义的平衡函数进行矩匹配，因而无法实现完全的分布平衡。为解决这一局限，我们提出基于核化矩平衡的直接预测方法。与现有目标函数不同，KMB-DF 能够从再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中自适应地选择最具信息量的平衡函数，从而实现充分的分布平衡。我们推导出一个易于处理且可微的公式，使其能够基于经验样本进行估计，并无缝集成到基于梯度的训练流程中。在多个数据集上开展的大量实验（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出 KMB-DF 方法，通过从再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中自适应地选择最有信息量的平衡函数来实施核化矩匹配，克服了现有方法只能匹配少数预定义矩的局限，从而实现深度时间序列预测中预测分布与真实分布的充分平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes KMB-DF, which adaptively selects the most informative balancing functions from a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) to perform kernelized moment balancing, overcoming the limitation of existing objectives that match only one or two predefined moments and thereby achieving sufficient distribution balance in deep time-series forecasting.
